# garim

**Graphical ARIM messaging over an ARDOP TNC**

- **Version recorded:** 1.7
- **Categories:** `emcomm`, `packet`
- **Upstream:** <https://www.whitemesa.net/garim/garim.html>
- **Needs first:** `ardopcf`

## What it does

A graphical client for the ARIM protocol -- keyboard chat, messages and file transfer between stations over an ARDOP TNC on HF. The FLTK counterpart to the curses `arim` program, by the same author.

## Why you would want it

EMCOMM file transfer over ARDOP without Winlink infrastructure: point-to-point, no gateway needed. Pairs with the `ardopcf` this catalog already carries; the closed-source equivalent path (VARIM over VARA) is post-1.0.

## Before it will work

A running ARDOP TNC -- `ardopcf`, configured for your rig and audio -- and rig audio/PTT working. gARIM connects to the TNC's TCP port.

## How it installs

- source (autotools) from https://www.whitemesa.net/garim/src/garim-1.7.tar.gz
  - build dependencies: `build-essential`, `libfltk1.3-dev`
  - configure.ac checks for fltk-config, so libfltk1.3-dev is the one real dependency beyond the toolchain -- the same FLTK the W1HKJ family already pulls in.

## Known problems

Note the ardopcf caveat this catalog records: CM108 PTT keying in ardopcf is suspect; serial and VOX keying are unaffected. gARIM inherits whatever keying path the TNC uses.

## Keeping it current

- probe: none
- strategy: rebuild
- Versioned tarballs at whitemesa.net/garim/src/; the help page states the current version. Slow-moving, single-author (NW8L).

## Where to get help with the software itself

Robert Cunnings NW8L, via the ARDOP users group (ardop.groups.io) -- linked from the help page.
